jobs.description_text: About the Role We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our team and help build Jade, Chime's AI-powered financial assistant. As a senior engineer on this team, you'll work across the full breadth of what it takes to bring an AI product to life — from designing new agent capabilities and conversation experiences to building the eval frameworks, observability, and guardrail systems that ensure Jade is reliable and safe for millions of members. You'll shape how Jade reasons, acts, and improves over time. You'll build member-facing capabilities that help people manage their spending, stay on top of subscriptions, and hit their financial goals. You'll also develop internal tools, dashboards, and backend services for model routing, prompt management, agent orchestration, and evaluation pipelines. The AI landscape evolves rapidly, and so does Jade. You'll need to learn quickly, adapt to shifting priorities, and proactively identify what's needed next — whether that's a new financial capability, a better way to test conversations, or a system to keep quality high as we scale. If you're excited about the unique challenges of shipping LLM-powered products at scale, this is the role for you. jobs.description_text: About the Role Chime is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the future of member-facing AI. You’ll set the technical direction for how we build with LLMs, architecting the agent systems, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails that enable us to deliver AI experiences that are reliable, safe, and scalable to millions of members. You’ll stay deeply hands-on, designing new agent capabilities and conversational experiences, rapidly prototyping and shipping production code, and raising the technical bar across the team. You’ll bring strong engineering fundamentals and a product mindset, owning capabilities from problem definition through measurement and iteration. You’ll join the AI & App Experience (AAX) organization and help build Jade, Chime’s AI-powered financial assistant. AAX is creating the next generation of the Chime member experience, with Jade at the center, helping millions of members better understand their finances, manage spending and subscriptions, and make progress toward their financial goals through experiences that feel natural, useful, and trustworthy. The AI landscape evolves rapidly, so does Chime. You'll need to learn quickly, adapt to shifting priorities, and proactively identify what's needed next, whether that's a new financial capability, a better way to evaluate conversations, or a system to keep quality high as we scale. If you're excited by the unique challenges of building LLM-powered products at scale, this is the role for you. The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $223,000.00 and up to $308,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. jobs.description_text: About the Role Chime serves millions of members on a mission to help them unlock financial progress. Growth Engineering builds the product surfaces and systems that turn that mission into measurable outcomes for members — running fast, data-informed experiments to acquire, activate, and deepen member relationships at scale. This role sits on our Early Stage Experience area, focused on the beginning of the member journey — the first experiences that turn new sign-ups into engaged, active members. It's high-volume, high-stakes work where small improvements compound, and the systems behind it have to be both quick to experiment on and dependable at scale. jobs.description_text: About the role The Human Agent Tooling team builds the software Chime's support agents use every day to help members. When a member has a problem a bot can't solve, a human agent picks it up — and the tools we build are what let that agent understand the member's situation, take the right action, and resolve the issue quickly and safely. That includes the agent workspace, case management, the systems that surface member context in real time, and the controls that govern what actions agents can take. Our mission is to make every human support interaction faster, safer, and more effective. When our tools work well, agents resolve issues in fewer clicks and members get better answers — and we measure our success by both. We're investing heavily in this platform: modernizing the agent experience, building safer and more granular access controls, and improving how agent tooling connects to the rest of Chime's systems. We work closely with Product, Operations, and the agents themselves to shape what great support tooling looks like. The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $117,000.00 and up to $162,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience. In this role, you can expect to Agent workspace — Contribute to the tools agents use to view member context, manage cases, and take action. You'll build well-scoped features that make agents' day-to-day faster and less error-prone. These systems handle sensitive moments and need to be correct and reliable.
